ablation.rule.R2.statement: Push the clean wells, choke the watered ones.

ablation.rule.R3.statement: Shut after N months of loss, reopen only with a margin.
ablation.rule.R4.name: ESP threshold
ablation.rule.R4.statement: Do not cross a pump size boundary unless the extra rate pays for the pump.
ablation.rule.R5.name: Voidage replacement

ablation.rule.R6.name: Conversion to injection
ablation.rule.R6.statement: Convert a well when it is worth more as an injector than as a producer.
ablation.rule.R7.name: Cyclic operation
ablation.rule.R7.statement: Periodically shut the heavily watered wells to mobilise the trapped oil.
